data.one_liner: Build complex views with rich text, borders, shadows, and relative child layouts.
data.what_it_does: FSuper helps developers quickly build complex views by providing a single widget that handles backgrounds, gradients, custom corners, borders, shadows, rich text, red notification dots, neumorphic styles, and up to two positioned child widgets.
use_when: You need to build complex styled views, cards, or chat bubbles quickly without nesting multiple containers.
You want easy support for Neumorphic UI styles or custom gradients and borders.
avoid_when: You are working with an infinite parent container and need to set width or height to double.infinity.
You prefer composing native Flutter widgets (Container, DecoratedBox, Stack) over a single multi-purpose widget.
strengths: Combines background, border, corner, shadow, and text properties into one widget.
Supports up to two positioned child widgets with custom relative alignments and offsets.
weaknesses: Can lead to massive widget parameter lists for single components.
data.minimal_example:
FSuper(
  margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 0),
  width: double.infinity,
  text: "This is FSuper!",
  backgroundColor: Color(0xffffc900),
)
